trigger: Code audit found that transparent Observation V1 computed goal and specific_increment by conjoining other gates, although the frozen dataset and method define the four gates as independently supervised variables.

owner_time_entity_valid: explicitly withdrawn, replaced, superseded, resolved, or stale stored item
MP response preference is owned by the user and is not invalid merely because the current story concerns another person
goal_function_fit: component-specific requested function rather than topic similarity
RS exact support_move prerequisites rather than coarse strategy family
boundary_burden_compatible: stop, listen-only, no-probing, advice, and low-burden constraints
specific_increment: candidate specificity and current-dialogue redundancy only
owner, goal, and boundary must not alter this score

failure_rule: If this contract-correct implementation fails any frozen FIT gate, do not consume confirmation and stop V1.5 Observation repair. If FIT passes but confirmation fails, do not revise rules and do not authorize H-Step2.
success_rule: Only PASS on all FIT gates may consume confirmation once; only PASS on all frozen confirmation floors authorizes H-Step2. This does not create Step1 worth_opening labels.
